groups.name: Check
groups.blurb: Read a file or a site and see what is really there.

groups.name: Generate
groups.blurb: Build the fix from your own choices or your own site.

groups.name: Start here
groups.blurb: The scan finds the gaps. The tools close them, one at a time.

tools.name: llms.txt checker
tools.headline: Is your llms.txt really yours?
tools.description: Find out whether the file on your site was written for your brand or shipped by your platform.
tools.get: Whether the file exists, how it is built and whether it names your brand or reads like a platform default.

network: GET /api/llms-check?domain=: the server reads one llms.txt from the domain you enter
inventory.stores: nothing in the browser; the server keeps a one-way IP hash with a request counter for rate limiting (privacy.html)

tools.name: Compare two sites
tools.headline: Put two sites side by side.
tools.description: See where you and another site differ, check by check.
tools.get: Both scores and every check, and every AI crawler, where the two sites differ.

network: GET /api/scan?domain=, once per site, one after the other
inventory.stores: nothing in the browser beyond the two domains in the address bar; the server keeps a one-way IP hash with a request counter for rate limiting (privacy.html)

tools.name: robots.txt generator
tools.headline: Decide which AI crawlers get in.
tools.description: Pick the crawlers you allow and copy the file.
tools.give: The AI crawlers you want in and the ones you want out.
tools.get: A robots.txt file to copy or download.

inventory.stores: nothing; the file is built in the page and copied or downloaded from it

tools.name: Schema generator
tools.headline: Tell machines who you are.
tools.description: JSON-LD prefilled from your own site, ready to paste.
tools.give: A domain and the type of markup you want.
tools.get: JSON-LD with the title, description and language read from your homepage, and brackets where only you know the facts.

network: GET /api/site-info?domain=: the server reads the homepage of the domain you enter
inventory.stores: nothing in the browser; the server keeps a one-way IP hash with a request counter for rate limiting (privacy.html)

tools.name: Free scan
tools.headline: Start with a free scan.
tools.description: Read a site the way an AI crawler would and get the fix for every finding.
tools.get: A score out of 100, the access state of each tracked AI crawler and every failed check with its fix.

inventory.stores: nothing in the browser; the server keeps a one-way IP hash with a request counter for rate limiting (privacy.html)

flow.label: AI crawler access
flow.text: Review robots.txt rules for blocked AI crawlers

robots-txt.text: Put the file at the root of your site, then {scan} to check it. To see where you stand against another site, {compare}.

schema-generator.text: Paste the JSON-LD into the head of your page, then {scan} to check it. Next, see whether your {llms} is yours.

llms-txt-checker.text: {scan} to see how llms.txt sits beside the other checks. If the file is a platform default, the {mcp} can draft a replacement. Check every line of it.

compare.text: Where the other site is ahead on crawler access, use the {robots}. Where it is ahead on structured data, use the {schema}. Where it has a file you lack, use the {llms}.

mcpCard.line: The scanner, the fix generators and the playbooks also run as tools inside Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients.
